title: Middle East war live: Putin receives Iran’s foreign minister amid stalled US-Iran talks
summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin plans to meet with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi on Monday, Russian state media reported. Moscow and Tehran, which are both subject to heavy Western sanctions, have developed an increasingly close relationship in recent years. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
contentText: Iran has offered to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and asked the US to end its naval blockade of the country as part of a proposal to the US, two regional officials said on Monday. The new proposal does not address Iran's nuclear program and likely won't be supported by US President Donald Trump, who has so far demanded Iran ends its atomic program as a condition for a permanent ceasefire. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
